title: Laser Hair Removal Cost in Dubai
h1: Laser hair removal cost in Dubai: full price list by area
desc: How much laser hair removal costs in Dubai, area by area: single sessions from AED 50 + VAT and 3 and 6 session packages, with what affects the price.
answer: At Skin & Laser, laser hair removal costs from AED 50 + VAT per session for small areas such as the upper lip, AED 100 + VAT for underarms, AED 350 + VAT for full legs and AED 550 + VAT for full body. Packages of 3 or 6 sessions cost less per session; full body is AED 2,800 + VAT for 6 sessions.
body:
## What affects the price

- The size of the area
- How many sessions you book together
- Your hair and skin type, which affects how many sessions you need

## Saving with packages

Booking 3 or 6 sessions brings the price per session down. As most areas need 6 to 8 sessions, a 6-session package is usually the best value.
prices: Small areas (lip, chin or jawline), 1 session
faq: How much is full body laser in Dubai?
AED 550 + VAT per session at Skin & Laser, or AED 2,800 + VAT for 6 sessions.
How many sessions will I pay for?
Your plan and price are confirmed at the consultation before treatment.
